title: Cold versus warmed Doom session

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: Doom environment identity includes generated profile/module artifacts and lazy package activation state, not just user declarations.
hypothesis: The generated module file should exist and list declared modules; package autoload files should exist before the corresponding feature is loaded in a clean batch process.
minimal_fixture: Filesystem-only inspection under `emacs --quick --batch`; no user Doom session is opened.
predicted_behavior: Generated modules and autoloads exist while features such as Magit are not loaded in the clean probe process.

independent_checks.name: generated module file records Magit module
independent_checks.detail: found or not found in first 4000 chars

independent_checks.name: Magit feature is not loaded in clean quick batch

counterexample: Inferring readiness from `doom!' declarations confuses module declaration with installed package, autoload, loaded feature, active mode, or external service.
derived_gym_requirement: Gym environment identity must record Doom core/user config/generated profile/package build ids and current feature/mode/service readiness separately.
